import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')

def test_upgrade_v1_yes():
    """Test v1 record with 'yes' remote -> work_mode: remote"""
    v1_yes = {'id': 1, 'name': 'Alice', 'remote': 'yes'}
    result = upgrade(v1_yes)
    assert result == {'id': 1, 'title': 'Alice', 'work_mode': 'remote', 'version': 2}, f"Test failed: {result}"
    print("✓ test_upgrade_v1_yes passed")

def test_upgrade_v1_no():
    """Test v1 record with 'no' remote -> work_mode: office"""
    v1_no = {'id': 2, 'name': 'Bob', 'remote': 'no'}
    result = upgrade(v1_no)
    assert result == {'id': 2, 'title': 'Bob', 'work_mode': 'office', 'version': 2}, f"Test failed: {result}"
    print("✓ test_upgrade_v1_no passed")

def test_upgrade_v1_missing_remote():

    v1_missing = {'id': 3, 'name': 'Charlie'}

        return False

        return True

def test_upgrade_v2_idempotent():
    """Test v2 record is returned as equal copy (idempotent)"""
    v2_record = {'version': 2, 'id': 4, 'title': 'Diana', 'work_mode': 'remote'}
    result = upgrade(v2_record)
    assert result == v2_record, f"Test failed - should return equal copy: {result}"
    print("✓ test_upgrade_v2_idempotent passed")

def test_load_all_mixed():
    """Test load_all with mixed v1/v2 records"""
